method: SPI-90 at the end of the next three pentads: observed CHIRPS v3 through the last held pentad, CHIRPS3-GEFS forecasts after it; trend = move between U.S. Drought Monitor SPI bands (D0 -0.5, D1 -0.8, D2 -1.3, D3 -1.6, D4 -2.0)
